sources.title: Singrow — four strawberry labels in the NUS Sustainability Report 2023
sources.enumerated_scope: Four literal strawberry labels on the two-page Singrow profile, report pages 25–26. Report title verified on the cover and reporting scope on page 4.
sources.limitations: Historical institutional profile, not a current product catalog, independent trait trial, rights register or complete portfolio. Crystal is called a variety; the other three labels appear in the strawberry sales context and do not establish registered denominations. Color descriptions and climate-resilience wording remain source assertions. The report identifies its scope through December 2023; neither the old 2024 upload path nor the replacement 2026 upload path is a publication date. No exact publication day is established. The captioned Crystal photograph stays available on original PDF page 25, without reuse approval or an inferred identity bridge to the white Crystal in the earlier interview. The farm photograph on page 26 does not identify individual cultivars.
review_warnings: Historical 2023 report: current portfolio and product availability still need checking.

sources.title: Singrow — Ruby and Crystal in the August 2021 product interview
sources.enumerated_scope: The two literal strawberry product labels in the interview product-range paragraph; the named tomato and spinach are excluded.
sources.limitations: Historical founder interview, not independent verification, a current portfolio or a legal-rights record. Product labels do not establish registered denominations or approved breeder/owner roles. The article describes Crystal as white; the NUS report captions a red photograph as Crystal. Those identities are not reconciled. Ruby is not silently translated or merged with Rouge. Generic farm/fruit images are not assigned to either name. Technical, climate, health, yield and franchise-location assertions are outside this name-list scope.

sources.title: Surexport — strawberry and raspberry names in the April 2013 interview
sources.enumerated_scope: Five strawberry names and four raspberry names in the original interview; the export brand is excluded. Repeated seasonal mentions are not additional varieties.
sources.limitations: Historical production/marketing interview, not a current company portfolio, independent trial or current rights register. Exclusive-rights wording is a historical company claim, not an approved role or current legal status. Strawberry Victoria is not the catalog blackberry of the same name. No breeder-code bridge, alias, patent, present availability or growing footprint is inferred. The preserved Victoria caption has no associated article photo in the current HTML; related-article and advertising images are not cultivar photos.
